name: Ludo World Master
description: A production Ludo gaming platform featuring real-time multiplayer, double-entry financial ledger, BullMQ background workers, Neon PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis, and a production-grade multi-chain custodial USDT wallet subsystem across 7 EVM networks (Ethereum Sepolia, Arbitrum Sepolia, BSC Testnet, Polygon Amoy, Base Sepolia, OP Sepolia, Avalanche Fuji).
